description.value: Walmart Supercentre is a large-format big-box grocery and general merchandise store in Westbank, just west of Kelowna on the south shore of Okanagan Lake. As a Supercentre, it carries a full grocery section alongside clothing, electronics, and household goods, making it a one-stop resupply point on the Okanagan touring corridor. Cyclists passing through on Highway 97 or the Okanagan rail trail will find this a convenient place to stock up on food, supplies, and incidentals.
